name: Hólasandslína 3 B120-135x135
description: Precast pad foundation with a tapered transition; the pedestal leans 1:8 toward the tower and sits off-centre.

provenance.notes: Dimensions from Hólasandslína 3 production drawing B120-135x135 (V20-032, BM Vallá, 2020-05-20, page 7); title block 0.6 m³. Pedestal leans 1:8 (7.125°) toward the tower and its base sits 50 mm off the pad centre, from the drawing's plan dimensions; its top and base are modelled horizontal (on the drawing the top is square to the pedestal axis, <1% difference in cross-section).
